cases.final_sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.fsq_place_id) AS place_count FROM places p JOIN place_categories pc ON pc.fsq_place_id = p.fsq_place_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = pc.category_id WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY place_count DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: 酒店和咖啡店分别收录了多少个地点？
cases.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.fsq_place_id) AS place_count, c.category_name FROM places p JOIN place_categories pc ON pc.fsq_place_id = p.fsq_place_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = pc.category_id WHERE (c.category_name = 'Hotel' OR c.category_name = 'Coffee Shop') GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_name ASC
cases.final_answer: 酒店收录 2318 个地点，咖啡店收录 3290 个地点。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.fsq_place_id) AS place_count FROM place_categories pc JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = pc.category_id WHERE c.category_name IN ('Hotel', 'Coffee Shop') GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_name ASC

cases.question: 在能够明确识别所属行政区的地点中，留有联系电话的地点主要集中在哪五个区？
cases.final_sql: SELECT canonical_district, COUNT(DISTINCT fsq_place_id) AS place_count FROM places WHERE canonical_district IS NOT NULL AND tel IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(tel) <> '' GROUP BY canonical_district ORDER BY place_count DESC LIMIT 5
cases.final_answer: 能够明确识别所属行政区且留有联系电话的地点主要集中在 Pudong（2677 个）、Xuhui（2309 个）、Changning（2070 个）、Huangpu（2040 个）和 Jing'an（688 个）这五个区。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT canonical_district, COUNT(*) AS place_count FROM places WHERE canonical_district IS NOT NULL AND tel IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(tel) <> '' GROUP BY canonical_district ORDER BY place_count DESC, canonical_district ASC LIMIT 5

cases.final_sql: SELECT canonical_district, COUNT(DISTINCT fsq_place_id) AS place_count FROM places WHERE canonical_district IS NOT NULL AND 1 = 1 GROUP BY canonical_district ORDER BY place_count DESC LIMIT 10
cases.final_answer: 能够明确识别所属行政区的地点前 10 名是：1. Pudong（14569 个）；2. Changning（9284 个）；3. Xuhui（9054 个）；4. Huangpu（7229 个）；5. Jing'an（1705 个）；6. Minhang（1624 个）；7. Putuo（782 个）；8. Hongkou（564 个）；9. Yangpu（520 个）；10. Chongming（232 个）。

cases.question: 在能够明确识别所属行政区的地点中，哪个区的咖啡店最多？
cases.final_sql: SELECT p.canonical_district, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.fsq_place_id) AS place_count FROM places p JOIN place_categories pc ON pc.fsq_place_id = p.fsq_place_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = pc.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Coffee Shop' AND p.canonical_district IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.canonical_district ORDER BY place_count DESC LIMIT 1
cases.final_answer: 能够明确识别所属行政区的咖啡店最多的是 Pudong，共有 464 家。
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.canonical_district, COUNT(DISTINCT p.fsq_place_id) AS coffee_shop_count FROM places p JOIN place_categories pc ON pc.fsq_place_id = p.fsq_place_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = pc.category_id WHERE p.canonical_district IS NOT NULL AND c.category_name = 'Coffee Shop' GROUP BY p.canonical_district ORDER BY coffee_shop_count DESC, p.canonical_district ASC LIMIT 1
